title: Scoreboard explorer polish
lede: The shared Scoreboard now reads as a current-season explorer: official record first, URL-backed stacked filters, a findable leaderboard, and person pages that keep the stack you opened from.

sections.heading: After-only evidence
sections.note: Authenticated local Admin preview at http://127.0.0.1:3000/scoreboard?sportCode=FB and /scoreboard/cmp2zpffw0009k004cyjkkexq?sportCode=FB (Maddy Pehler). Desktop Chromium, dark appearance. No frozen matched before pair was captured for this explorer polish; HEAD is not the user's dirty baseline.

changes.was: Report chrome, orange/red rank medals, and a Snapshot that could name a pending filter while totals still showed the last intersection.
changes.now: Team record leads with a W–L–T meter. Snapshot labels follow the last loaded intersection. First/second/third use identity, not warning/problem colors.

changes.was: Filters lived only in component state, so refresh and person drill-in dropped Football.
changes.now: Sport, venue, opponent, site, and rank live in the URL. Opening a person keeps the stack; sport and site filter that Scoreboard; All leaders returns to /scoreboard?sportCode=FB.

changes.was: The leaderboard was a long unscanned list, and a name search still claimed 13 people.
changes.now: Search finds Maddy Pehler at rank 6, the card says 1 match · Football, and You’re 2nd clears search and jumps to your row.

verification: 18 focused tests passed in scoreboard-explorer, team-scoreboard-page-source, and scoreboard-sport-filter-source.
ESLint passed on the touched Scoreboard explorer files.
Authenticated Admin browser: team Football 0–1 / 3 events / 13 people; You’re 2nd; search pehl → Maddy Pehler rank 6; person Football 0–1 vs Notre Dame; All leaders restored ?sportCode=FB.
Phone-width smoke at 390×844 showed stacked filters, You’re 2nd, and the Football chip above the tab bar. The capture is letterboxed in a wider browser frame.
git diff --check was run on the slice files.
npm run build:app was not rerun because npm run dev:preview is occupying 127.0.0.1:3000.
